nodes.description: Primary EBV infection provokes a massive, largely oligoclonal expansion of EBV-specific CD8+ T cells (with an NK-cell response), selectively raising CD8+ not CD4+ numbers and inverting the CD4:CD8 ratio. These activated cells are the atypical lymphocytes of the blood film, and their magnitude tracks disease severity.
